The fish has a long, streamlined body with visible scales, a prominent jaw, and appears to be a barracouta or similar species. There is a digital timestamp in the bottom right corner.

Some scale patterns appear slightly repetitive or 'painted' rather than individually distinct, though this may also be due to low image resolution/compression.
